Subject: Follow-up: Procurement path & next steps (Redwood trial)

Hi Samantha / Tom -

Thanks again for taking the time today - great discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on procurement readiness and the commercial path:

- Summary: Acme wants to run a 4-week POC on a dedicated capacity pool for internal search and a customer-facing chat feature.
- Needs we heard: predictable performance SLA, data isolation, and evidence for SOC2/compliance.

Open items for procurement / commercial:
1) Billing path: do you prefer PO (purchase order) or card for the POC and future production? Any threshold where PO is required?
2) Marketplaces: are you interested in transacting via AWS Marketplace or a direct contract? If marketplace, what is your expected onboarding timeline?
3) Budget owners & signatory path: who is the economic buyer / finance sponsor, and who signs contracts above $50k?
4) Payment terms: do you require Net30, Net45, or something else?

Attached: initial quote (Redwood-Quote-ACME-20260423.pdf), high-level SOW (SOW-Redwood-Acme.docx), SOC2 summary (Redwood-SOC2-report.pdf). I can send a redlineable quote and an abbreviated commercial summary for procurement.

Proposed next step: 30-minute sync between procurement + finance + our commercial lead (I can bring Vivek) - are you available early next week?

Thanks -
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Apr 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Procurement path & next steps (Redwood trial)

Hi Marissa -

Thanks for the recap, that looks right from our side. A few answers and context from procurement:

- Billing preference: For POCs under $10k we typically process via corporate card. Anything above $10k-50k is evaluated on a case-by-case basis; standard production deals >$50k will go on a PO. VP Finance signs contracts above $50k.
- Marketplaces: We are evaluating AWS Marketplace, but procurement needs to confirm if Marketplace billing is approved for this business unit - timeline ~3-4 weeks for onboarding (we can try to expedite if needed).
- Budget owners / signatory: Economic buyer is Maria Gonzalez (Maria.Gonzalez@acmecorp.com), VP Finance; day-to-day finance sponsor is Tom Alvarez. Signatory path for >$50k: VP Finance signs; legal also reviews.
- Payment terms: Net30 preferred.

I've attached our procurement questionnaire (ACME-Procurement-Questionnaire.xlsx) for your legal/commercial team to complete - procurement@acmecorp.com is the intake mailbox. If you can send a formal quote + SOW, procurement will use that to generate a PO.

Samantha Lee
Head of Procurement | Acme Corp
samantha.lee@acmecorp.com
